answer: Resist sybils with work-coupled identity: an agent's standing is built layer by layer, like soil rising on a knoll — every epoch it must countersign real transactions, and only checkpoint-covered work moves its trust weight. One honest identity attests cheaply because the work itself earns. An attacker splitting through a prism of fake identities pays the full cost per clone: compute, bandwidth, and epochs of waiting, with no shortcut to buy history. Rewards flow like nectar only where real work exists; sybils wither because cloning multiplies cost without multiplying yield.
